# Only one thing looks focused while typing in the settings search (fix/narr112). Compare each shot with the same
# script on main.
# - narr112-done: Shift+Tab from nothing puts the white focus ring on Done (the same on both).
# - narr112-typing: then Ctrl+F. On the branch only the search box at the top of the sidebar is outlined (the purple
#   outline of a box being typed in). On main the white ring also stays round Done, so two things look focused.
# - narr112-results: "glow" typed. On the branch still only the search box's purple outline; on main the white ring is
#   still round Done under the results.
# - narr112-cleared: Esc. The search is cleared, the Look tab is back and the white ring is round Done again (both).
# - narr112-row-typing: Tab three times (the Lyrics switch, Preview, then the first setting of the Look tab), then
#   Ctrl+F. On the branch only the search box's purple outline; on main the white ring also stays round that setting.
# What the Narrator says (Search cleared, a setting's place, a setting that disappears) can't be seen here: FocusTest and
# NarrationTest check those rules.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/narr112 -f script=.github/checks/narr112.txt

cmd time set noon
cmd weather clear
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 3
gui 1
sleep 2
key tab shift
sleep 1
shot narr112-done
key f ctrl
sleep 1
shot narr112-typing
type glow
sleep 1
shot narr112-results
key escape
sleep 1
shot narr112-cleared
key tab
sleep 0.3
key tab
sleep 0.3
key tab
sleep 1
key f ctrl
sleep 1
shot narr112-row-typing
key escape
sleep 0.3
close
guiscale 0
